description: This file defines the Coocook::Controller::Permission class, a controller in a Perl web application managing project permissions, including listing, adding, editing, making owners, and revoking permissions.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Permission
classes.description: Controller class handling project permission management in a web application.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the list of permissions for a project, including organization and user permissions, with options to edit, revoke, or transfer ownership.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles adding new permissions to a project for organizations or users based on submitted parameters.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures and sets the permission object in the stash based on the provided identifier, for subsequent actions.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Updates the role of an existing permission.

methods.name: make_owner
methods.description: Transfers project ownership to a specified permission, if capable.

methods.name: revoke
methods.description: Revokes (deletes) a permission from the project.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to the permissions index page.
